findings.fix: Prove the `KernelForm`-level lemma once, e.g. `theorem KernelForm.isBigO_moment_add_plusCoeff_mul_log (P : KernelForm) (h : (fun n : ℕ => ∫ z in (0:ℝ)..1, P.regular z * z ^ n) =O[atTop] fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)⁻¹) : (fun n : ℕ => P.moment (n+1) + P.plusCoeff * (Real.log (n+1) + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) - P.deltaCoeff) =O[atTop] fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)⁻¹`, and derive both kernel statements from it, each discharging only its own regular-part bound.
findings.issue: `isBigO_moment_pqq_add_log_inv` and `isBigO_moment_pgg_add_log_inv` duplicate one argument for two special cases. Both reduce to `(-plusCoeff) * (harmonic N - log N - γ) + (regular-part moment)` via `KernelForm.pairing_pow` (NormalForm.lean:190), then apply `isBigO_harmonic_sub_log_sub_eulerMascheroniConstant_inv` plus an ad-hoc rational bound; only the rational bound differs. The general fact — for any `P : KernelForm` whose regular-part moment is `O(1/N)`, `P.moment N + P.plusCoeff * (log N + γ) - P.deltaCoeff =O[atTop] (N:ℝ)⁻¹` — is stated in the module docstring ("as the coefficients 2 C_F and 2 C_A of `[1 / (1 - z)]₊` dictate", lines 30-32) but nowhere in Lean.

summary: The supersymmetric-point material sits at the right level (arbitrary colour record, distributional form, real N > 1 with the minimal integrability hypothesis). The two large-N expansions, however, are the same KernelForm-level fact proved twice for two special cases; the general statement that the log coefficient is the plus coefficient and the constant the delta coefficient is asserted in the docstring but never stated.
